We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. We are seeking a Cloud Performance Engineer to work with technology teams across the firm to build high-performance cloud solutions for trading workloads. You will join the Cloud Performance Team, working alongside cloud engineers, software developers, Linux- and network engineers to optimize performance end to end. The ideal candidate draws on experience in cloud technology, systems engineering, networking and automation. What You Will Do In This Role Design and implement cloud and hybrid cloud architectures for latency-sensitive trading workloads. Build and maintain systems that continuously monitor the latency characteristics of distributed hybrid workloads. Work on orchestration tooling for provisioning cloud resources as well as networking configurations and server-side processes Build backend systems for collecting performance metrics and tooling to query it Required Qualifications 4+ years of experience working with Amazon Web Services (AWS), with deep knowledge of networking and compute services (EC2, VPC, Direct Connect). Good overview of the AWS service landscape and core concepts such as IAM Experience in using IaC tools such as Terraform to manage both cloud infrastructure and a broad set of compute and networking resources (docker, K8s, Cisco devices) Experience in network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, routing, switching, HTTP) and major routing protocols Solid understanding of Linux systems and the Linux network stack Strong background in automation via Bash scripting and Python programming, ideally in conjunction with orchestration through serverless cloud services. Demonstratable experience working with modern AI coding agents, balancing rapid prototyping with critical review to ensure simplicity and quality of deliverables Able to implement systems with a security-first mindset, adhering to firm-wide security policies, and best practice implementations. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently drive work to completion Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams Preferred Qualifications Experience building data pipelines for centralizing structured data Experience working with Cisco routing and switching hardware Experience working with Google Cloud Platform Experience programming in a compiled languages (preferably Go or C++) Experience with Linux kernel bypass techniques such as DPDK. For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice. California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice. []

review_candidates.title: Virtualization Engineer
review_candidates.description: About us Plenit (formerly Jotelulu) is the Operating Platform for IT Service Providers. We help MSPs, ISVs, VARs, and IT resellers run, scale, and grow their businesses on top of our own sovereign infrastructure, with footprint across Europe and the Americas. We are a European cloud platform with a clear conviction: digital sovereignty matters, and the IT channel deserves a partner that speaks their language, builds for their reality, and stays close to the ground. We are not enterprise-y. We are simple, pragmatic, and obsessed with our partners’ success. Five years in, we are 130 people, four countries, and growing fast — which is exactly why we are bringing this role on now. We’re passionate about technology, but we’re also a bit geeky—we love Star Wars, video games, 90s movies, and pop culture. We work hard and with passion, but we also have a great time together. At Plenit, you’ll find a balance between work and fun, where teammates often become friends, and boredom is rare—there’s always something new, unexpected, and memorable happening. The challenge We're at a pivotal stage in the evolution of our cloud platform. To continue scaling efficiently and strengthening reliability, we are evolving our virtualization platform within our IaaS environment. Our infrastructure supports mission-critical services, where performance, stability and continuous improvement are key. As a Virtualization Engineer , your mission will be to design, deploy, operate and evolve virtualization infrastructures based on KVM in production environments. You will contribute directly to the evolution of the virtualization layer, participate in architecture decisions, and help improve infrastructure-related products. You will play a key role in resolving critical incidents, analyzing high-impact escalations from the operations team, and optimizing performance, stability and efficiency of the platform. You will also contribute to reducing operational friction through automation and continuous improvement. You'll be part of a highly collaborative engineering environment, working closely with Network, Systems, Storage and Operations teams to solve cross-functional issues and ensure the platform evolves in a scalable and reliable way. Collaboration will be essential. You will support infrastructure decisions, participate in architecture changes, migrations and capacity expansions, proactively identify improvements, and ensure the platform continues to evolve with a strong technical foundation. Requirements that are important for us Experience in administration and support of virtualization environments based on KVM in production. Proven experience in implementation, operation and troubleshooting of virtualization platforms. Advanced knowledge of Linux system administration. Strong understanding of KVM virtualization stack, including QEMU and libvirt. Experience diagnosing complex issues related to performance, capacity, availability and stability. Practical knowledge of networking in virtualized environments: bonding (link aggregation), VLANs or VXLANs, firewall rules (iptables). Key skills and expected impact Strong documentation practices and contribution to technical procedures and operational best practices. Optimization of performance, stability and efficiency of the virtualization platform. Ability to lead root cause analysis and propose technical improvements to reduce incident recurrence. Resolution of complex and critical incidents escalated by the operations team. Contribution to automation to reduce manual and repetitive operational tasks. Technical judgment in validating new solutions, designs and changes impacting the virtualization layer. Acting as a technical reference, contributing to raising the overall technical level with practical knowledge and global vision. Nice to have Experience with infrastructure orchestration platforms such as OpenStack, CloudStack or similar. Experience in cloud providers, IaaS platforms or large-scale infrastructure environments. Knowledge of centralized storage (NFS, iSCSI) and distributed storage (Ceph). Experience in high availability, capacity planning and resource optimization. Familiarity with observability, monitoring and performance analysis tools. Experience with automation tools such as Ansible. Participation in architecture evolution, standardization or platform improvement projects. Ability to document technical decisions and communicate clearly in multidisciplinary environments. Tools Virtualization: KVM, QEMU, libvirt Networking: bonding, VLANs, VXLANs, iptables Storage: NFS, iSCSI, Ceph Orchestration: OpenStack, CloudStack or similar Automation: Ansible or similar Observability & performance: monitoring and performance analysis tools Collaboration & documentation: technical procedures and operational documentation

review_candidates.title: Data Center Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Albany International is a global advanced textiles and materials processing company with two core businesses. Albany Engineered Composites is a rapidly growing supplier of highly engineered composite parts for the aerospace industry. Machine Clothing is the world's leading producer of custom-designed fabrics and belts essential to production in the paper, nonwovens, and other process industries. About Global Information Services (GIS) Global Information Services is the team within Albany chartered with providing leading-edge systems and technologies to internal users as well as Albany customers. GIS provides services ranging from Information Technology Strategy to infrastructure development and maintenance, with a unique and intense focus on customer service. About Our Enterprise Data Services Group Our Enterprise Data Services group is responsible for Albany’s Global Data Centers which will house many of the Enterprise Systems, including PTC WindChill, Intranet, operational support and manufacturing processing systems. Our professional team of engineers works with the latest in new infrastructure technologies in combination with other GIS departments to ensure a functional, well-performing, reliable, and secure environment for our enterprise applications and communications needs. The Data Center Engineer is responsible for operating and managing the organization’s Global Data Centers in alignment with the Global Information Services (GIS) strategy and objectives. This role involves planning, coordinating, and executing IT‑related initiatives while providing technical support to internal GIS teams. The Data Center Engineer collaborates closely with departmental leaders to identify needs, recommend solutions, and implement cost‑effective technologies that support the organization’s operational and strategic goals. Responsibilities: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot enterprise storage, compute, data protection, and networking systems on an ongoing basis. Implement enterprise‑level data center solutions across architecture, security, data protection, disaster recovery, monitoring, and provisioning. Ensure all solutions align with organizational policies, platform standards, cloud strategies, data governance, and reference architectures. Provide engineering expertise and escalation support to operations and functional teams. Conduct root cause analysis and deliver recommendations to prevent recurrence of issues. Provision and decommission virtual compute and storage resources within Hyper-V and Azure IaaS environments. Install, configure, operate, and maintain data center hardware, software, and related infrastructure, including Hyper-V virtualization, NetApp storage, and Dell servers. Document technology implementations and operational procedures to ensure adherence to established standards and best practices. Oversee server, storage, and backup monitoring while maintaining accurate infrastructure documentation and compliance with IT standards. Maintain deep knowledge of data center architecture, industry trends, and emerging technologies to ensure optimal utilization of enterprise assets. Shift Day Experience/Education/Skills Formal Education & Certification BS Degree in computer science or engineering Microsoft Azure certification or training Knowledge & Experience 3–5 years of experience working with data center technologies in an engineering role with progressively increasing responsibilities. Demonstrated knowledge and hands‑on implementation of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, and Performance Tuning best practices. Experience in manufacturing or Department of Defense (DoD) environments is highly desirable. Strong understanding of enterprise‑level storage, compute, and networking concepts and technologies. Advanced proficiency with Azure IaaS components, including compute (VMs, containers, serverless, PaaS services), storage (Blob, File Share, Storage Accounts), and networking (Azure Firewall, NSGs, VNETs). Experience administering Windows and Linux server systems in Hyper-V and Azure IaaS environments. Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking, including ACLs, VLANs, and routing. Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring tools such as Azure Monitor and SCOM. Strong skills in configuration management, Infrastructure‑as‑Code, scripting, and markup languages (PowerShell, YAML, JSON, Ansible, Terraform). Solid understanding of Azure cloud security principles, including NSGs, RBAC, service‑to‑service authentication, least‑privilege access models, and environment segmentation. Operational proficiency applying ITSM frameworks to daily workflows and processes. Personal Attributes Strong supervisory and leadership skills. Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to conduct and direct research into IT issues and products. Ability to present ideas in business-friendly and user-friendly language. Highly self-motivated, self-directed, and attentive to detail. Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment. Extensive experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Embrace continuous learning to broaden and harden technical, business, written and verbal communication skills.
